key_insight: ClinVerse moves medical AI training and evaluation beyond static questions into interactive diagnostic simulations with multi-agent coordination.
clinical_relevance: The environment tests how AI agents gather patient information, request examinations, and form diagnoses, without establishing readiness for clinical use.
method: Ground simulations in ClinPatient, a dataset of 150,000 diagnostic cases derived from real-world electronic health records.
Coordinate six specialized clinical roles as a doctor agent interviews patients, requests examinations, and produces a diagnosis.
Use rule-based trajectory scores for information acquisition, examination ordering, and diagnostic accuracy as training rewards and evaluation measures.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that nine self-evolution methods across three categories consistently improved diagnostic capabilities among evaluated general-purpose and medical-domain models within ClinVerse.
watch_item: Performance gains in this simulated, rule-scored environment do not establish real-world clinical safety or patient benefit.
paper_title: ClinVerse: A Realistic Multi-Agent Diagnostic Environment for Training and Evaluating Medical Agents
